content.text: Bringing health through food to as many people as possible News and Stories from the UK Press release Story Press release Press release Press release Transparent reporting Proudly British Oats Wimbledon Spectator British Oats Investment Well Grounded More than 100 years of supporting health From our first yogurts in pharmacies, we have certainly come a long way in over 100 years. Our products, ranging from yogurts and plant-based products, to waters, and specialized nutrition products, are now part of everyday life in millions of households. We're proud to be present in over 120 countries around the world, making healthy eating and drinking accessible to as many people as possible. 89% of products sold belong to healthy categories 120+ countries where our products are sold 90,000 Danoners around the world CONTRIBUTING TO A HEALTHIER WORLD Our product categories in the UK Essential Dairy & Plant-Based products Waters Specialised Nutrition Dairy and Plant-based Products Water Brands Specialized Nutrition Careers Driving impact "My own career blends clinical expertise with commercial experience in a way I never imagined when I joined. That freedom to explore has kept me engaged, challenged, and inspired. It shows that stepping out isn’t just allowed - it’s actively supported, and it builds careers that are unique to each of us." - Kashena Senior Medical Science Liaison Manager Danone Impact Journey As part of our Renew Danone strategy, we have developed a sustainability roadmap based on three interconnected pillars: Health, Nature, and People & Communities. For each of these pillars, the company has set new priorities and objectives for the future, focusing on the areas where Danone can bring the most value. Promoting healthier food choices Preserving and regenerating nature Giving back to our community Promoting healthier food choices Supporting sustainable agriculture Giving back to our community Shaping the future of food today Our ever-growing understanding of microbiota unveils its extraordinary potential to significantly enhance our health Leading with science and technology, Danone is dedicated to innovating sustainable products that enhance health and nutrition for all
